body: (function () { var out = []; var nodes = document.querySelectorAll('li.b_algo'); for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) { var n = nodes[i]; if ((n.className || '').indexOf('b_ad') >= 0) continue; var a = n.querySelector('h2 a') || n.querySelector('a[href^=http]'); if (!a || !a.href) continue; var h = n.querySelector('h2'); var p = n.querySelector('.b_caption p') || n.querySelector('.b_caption') || n.querySelector('p'); out.push({ title: ((h && (h.innerText || h.textContent)) || (a.innerText || a.textContent) || '').trim(), url: a.href, snippet: ((p && (p.innerText || p.textContent)) || '').trim() }); } return JSON.stringify(out); })()
